title: Ox Passion Juicy Peach Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Juicy Peach highlights the delicate and aromatic qualities of stone fruit. Every draw presents the soft, nectar-like sweetness of ripe Peach, full of authentic and vibrant fruit character. The profile remains consistently smooth from inhale to exhale, providing a gentle and perfectly balanced fruit vape without ever overpowering the palate. Formulated with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid provides excellent versatility for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices. It pairs flawlessly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.8ohm, ensuring crisp flavour delivery and discreet vapour production alongside a silky throat hit. Developed by OXVA, a highly respected name in vaping hardware, the OX Passion Salts range offers a premium selection of e-liquids. These specialised blends are crafted to operate flawlessly with modern refillable vape devices, delivering a highly consistent vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths.
